task: Predict whether a chemical is ready biodegradable, from molecular descriptors of its structure.

feature_descriptions.J_Dz(e): Balaban-like index from Barysz matrix weighted by Sanderson electronegativity
feature_descriptions.F01[N-N]: Frequency of N-N at topological distance 1
feature_descriptions.F04[C-N]: Frequency of C-N at topological distance 4
feature_descriptions.NssssC: Number of atoms of type ssssC
feature_descriptions.F03[C-N]: Frequency of C-N at topological distance 3
feature_descriptions.HyWi_B(m): Hyper-Wiener-like index (log function) from Burden matrix weighted by mass
feature_descriptions.SM6_L: Spectral moment of order 6 from Laplace matrix
feature_descriptions.F03[C-O]: Frequency of C - O at topological distance 3
feature_descriptions.Me: Mean atomic Sanderson electronegativity (scaled on Carbon atom)
feature_descriptions.Mi: Mean first ionization potential (scaled on Carbon atom)
feature_descriptions.SpPosA_B(p): Normalized spectral positive sum from Burden matrix weighted by polarizability
feature_descriptions.B01[C-Br]: Presence/absence of C - Br at topological distance 1
feature_descriptions.B03[C-Cl]: Presence/absence of C - Cl at topological distance 3
feature_descriptions.SpMax_A: Leading eigenvalue from adjacency matrix (Lovasz-Pelikan index)
feature_descriptions.B04[C-Br]: Presence/absence of C - Br at topological distance 4
feature_descriptions.TI2_L: Second Mohar index from Laplace matrix
feature_descriptions.F02[C-N]: Frequency of C - N at topological distance 2
feature_descriptions.nHDon: Number of donor atoms for H-bonds (N and O)
feature_descriptions.SpMax_B(m): Leading eigenvalue from Burden matrix weighted by mass
feature_descriptions.Psi_i_A: Intrinsic state pseudoconnectivity index - type S average
feature_descriptions.SM6_B(m): Spectral moment of order 6 from Burden matrix weighted by mass
